title: An exploratory proposal requires review even at trivial impact under a permitting ceiling
rationale: Every ordinary condition for auto-acceptance holds: the preset permits exploratory proposals, the impact sits at or below the ceiling. The exploratory flag alone is what withholds auto-acceptance, because an exploratory proposal is not backed by the user’s own accumulated feedback.

requirement.text: They MUST be marked as exploratory, count against the proposalFrequency budget, are exempt from evidenceThreshold, and MUST NOT be auto-accepted regardless of impact class.
